description: Malformed `given` heads in `@v = match …` arms — a property path, a call, a comparison, a parenthesized name, a rebind — are refused (E-SYNTAX-044 ×4, E-SYNTAX-045), as they are in a statement match (S462 review M1).
rationale: §42.2.3: "A `given` head SHALL contain only an identifier-list"; the same head check now reads expression-position match arms.
